pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate
And eased thee of the burden
But lo! with hardship goeth ease
So when thou art relieved, still toil
And strive to please thy Lord

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Have We not expanded thee thy breast
And removed from thee thy burden
The which did gall thy back
And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)
So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief
Verily, with every difficulty there is relief
Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard
And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention
